  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  December 9, 2024
  6:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL: At 6:15 p.m., on Monday, December 9, 2024, the Alhambra City Council met in the
Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall.

PRESENT:  MAZA, MALONEY, ANDRADE-STADLER, LEE
ABSENT:  NONE

Officials Present: City Manager Binnquist, Assistant City Manager Garcia, Deputy City Manager
Hembree, City Attorney Montes, City Clerk Myles, Director of Parks and Recreation Macias, Director
of Finance Lieu, Director of Community Development Ho, Deputy Director of Public Works and Utilities
Ramos, Chief of Police Kennedy, Chief of Fire Department Ragusa, Director of Library Services
LohGuan, Director of Human Resources Ko, Battalion Chief Brown, Economic Development Specialist
Chew, Manager Analyst Alvarez

CONSENT AGENDA (Item No. 1)

All items listed under the Consent Agenda were considered by the City Council to be routine and were
enacted by one motion.

1.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION ACCEPTING THE OFFICIAL CERTIFICATE OF THE
  CANVASS OF THE ELECTION RETURNS AND STATEMENT OF VOTES CAST BY
  PRECINCT FOR THE OFFICES AT THE NOVEMBER 5, 2024 GENERAL MUNICIPAL
  ELECTION AND ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION PERTAINING TO THE DESIGNATION OF
  THE MEMBER AND ALTERNATE MEMBER OF THE BOARDS OF DIRECTORS OF LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY SANITATION DISTRICT NOS. 2 AND 16 – F2M24-38, R2M24-50,
  R2M24-51

  On November 5, 2024, a General Municipal Election was held in the City of Alhambra at which
  the offices of Councilpersons of the Third and Fourth Districts (full term of four years) were
  voted upon by the electorate. The November 5, 2024 election was consolidated with the
  Statewide General Election held that same date and the County of Los Angeles was requested
  to perform certain election services on the City’s behalf, including, but not limited to, canvassing
  the election returns. The County completed its canvass, the results of which were as follows:

  The canvass was ready for acceptance by the City Council

  Discussion:  None.

  Action Taken:  City Council, by one motion, took the following actions:

  1.  Adopted Resolution No. R2M24-50 entitled: A Resolution of the Alhambra City
  Council accepting the Official Certificate of the Canvass of the Election Returns and
  Statement of Votes Cast by Precinct for the Offices of the Third District and
  Councilperson of the Fourth District by the electorate at the November 5, 2024
  General Municipal Election and declaring the results thereof; and,

  2.  Adopted Resolution No. R2M24-51 entitled: A Resolution of the Alhambra City
  Council pertaining to the designation of the Member and Alternate Member of the
  Boards of Directors of County Sanitation District Nos. 2 And 16 of Los Angeles
  County

  Vote:  Moved:  MALONEY  Seconded:  MAZA
  Ayes:  MAZA, MALONEY, ANDRADE-STADLER, LEE
  Noes:  NONE
  Absent:  NONE

CEREMONIAL

2.  OATH OF OFFICE & FAREWELL CEREMONY – F2M24-38

  This evening the Alhambra City Council officially accepted the Canvass of Votes for the
  November 5th General Municipal Election and declared elected Jeff Maloney to the office
  of Councilperson of the Third District, and Nan “Noya” Wang to the office of
  Councilperson of the Fourth District, the terms of office for which positions shall be four
  years. Additionally, the City bid farewell to outgoing Mayor Sasha Renée Pérez who was
  elected to the California State Senate.

with the consent of the City Council, adjourned the meeting to the next regular City Council meeting
